root_instruction: Verify selected literal strings, enum values, service branches and click150 handling before implementation; do not treat the source/delegated inventories as complete PE verification. Snapshot/lifetime leaf does not implement/render this window.

owner_open.facts: lazy allocates/stores m_commandListWnd; UIWindow::Create(...,250,200); existing window is shown again

owner_close.facts: PostQuit on m_commandListWnd and clears pointer

on_create.facts: creates 3-state tab and scrollbar; m_itemVertNum=(cy-38)/20; two bitmap buttons use IDs 134 and 135; dimensions at owner are 250x200, so 8 visible rows x 2 columns = 16 slots/page

on_draw.facts: tab state 0 selects m_cmdOnOffTable, state 1 m_cmdExeTable, state 2 m_cmdWinTable; status checkbox image for each row is looked up by row TALKTYPE in m_cmdOnOffSet

click.facts: state 0/1 selected row dispatches g_modeMgr.m_curMode->SendMsg(47, row.second, 0, 0); state 2 calls UIWindowMgr::ProcessPushButton using selected window command ID

window_sendmsg.facts: handles scrollbar messages; child close button ID 135 deletes window ID 0x70

window.persistence: No command-list-specific persisted position/state found in inspected owner/open/close paths; manager constructs lazily, closes via PostQuit, and retains pointer only while open. General frame/window persistence was not exhaustively audited.
window.message_ids: No MsgStr numeric IDs are needed for the 23 row captions in these source paths; the captions are command strings. Window child/button IDs 134/135 are directly present in OnCreate.

window.row_source_and_relation: Ref/Session.cpp lines 23500-23755 append m_cmdOnOffTable in the above order, using command string symbols and TALKTYPE. Ref/Session.cpp lines 20426-20515 independently append 23 status (value,TALKTYPE) pairs to m_cmdOnOffSet in different order. OnDraw joins by TALKTYPE, so the status values control checked images for matching rows; the display list is not a direct positional view of m_cmdOnOffSet.
window.click_actions: All 23 on/off row clicks send mode message 47 with the row's TALKTYPE second value. Ref/GameMode.cpp handlers implement per-type toggles/actions; `set1` and `set2` have source-initialized status 0 and their exact click behavior should be interpreted from those handlers, not assumed to be a generic boolean toggle.
window.pe_evidence: Tag numeric values above are corroborated by static pair-immediate inventory at HighPriest.exe addresses 0x0064c5ac-0x0064c886 in build-recovery-unit-review/chat-command-flags-verified.json. UI source function addresses are decompiler labels; no independent UI-function disassembly audit was performed in this task.
ambiguities: Command label spellings are decompiler symbols (e.g. aBattlemode, aQ1); source does not inline their literal bytes here, so labels are represented by conventional source symbol text.
There are 23 status rows, but only 16 visible cells per page at the owner-provided size; scrollbar handles additional vertical pages.
m_cmdOnOffSet is joined by TALKTYPE; duplicate TALKTYPEs, if any, would use the first match in OnDraw. The 23 initializer tags in the current list are distinct.

execution_table.numeric_ids: The table stores TALKTYPE values by symbolic enum in the primary source. No numeric values are asserted here; they were not independently extracted from PE for every entry. OnLBtnDown separately tests literal second==150 and routes that case to SendMsg(47, type, params), with remaining rows routed to SendMsg(47,type,0,0); enum identity for 150 is left unresolved.

window_table.service_branch: g_serviceType==ServiceBrazil selects localized labels; otherwise standard labels. Both branches pair labels with the same sequence of symbolic values.

ui_contract.tabs: UITab m_numTab=3; state 0 on/off table, state 1 execution table, state 2 window table. Tab creation at OnCreate, tab child message 13.
ui_contract.geometry: Window manager case 112 calls Create(250,200). OnCreate sets 2 columns, 8 rows ((cy-38)/20), scrollbar at x=w-15,y=14,width=1,height=h-38. Cell hit-test uses xCell=x/(w/2), yCell=(y-17)/20, list area y>=17 and y<17+20*itemVertNum; item index uses row-major 2-column slots plus page offset m_itemHorzNum*m_viewOffset.
ui_contract.scroll: RecalcScrbarPos uses ceil(row_count/2), visible itemVertNum rows and clamps viewOffset to [0,totalRows-visibleRows]. OnWheel if vertical scrolling enabled sends scrollbar message 7 by max(1,min(itemVertNum-1,3)) rows; nonnegative wheel negates delta. Scrollbar messages 7/9/10 adjust viewOffset and recalc/invalidate.
ui_contract.hover: OnMouseHover recomputes GetCurItem and invalidates when selection changes. For non-window tabs it maps current index to command row and shows help balloon; for window tab it copies m_keyWinTable label. Cursor action becomes 2 for valid help selections. Out-of-cell GetCurItem returns -1; explicit cursor/help clearing on invalid hover was not apparent in inspected source; do not infer a reset.
ui_contract.click: OnLBtnDown recomputes selection; on tab 2 invokes ProcessPushButton with selected m_cmdWinTable value. Tabs 0/1 dispatch mode message 47 with selected TALKTYPE, except literal second==150 passes parameter array.

selected_pe_check.static_reference: HighPriest.exe.c identifies InitTalkTypeTable at 0x00663e20; command table source matches function. This supplemental pass did not disassemble the entire initializer to extract numeric values for m_cmdExeTable/m_cmdWinTable.
selected_pe_check.numeric_policy: No numeric TALKTYPE values are guessed or derived from unrelated parser maps. The per-PE numeric values remain unverified in this JSON.

limitations: Source strings are represented by decompiler string symbols; literal localized bytes were not independently extracted.
m_keyWinTable labels are a separate parallel array; OnDraw/hover use it for window-tab display. This task captured m_cmdWinTable creation entries only.
PE numeric IDs for all execution/window values remain unverified; the source enum labels and creation order are the evidence recorded here.
